rationale: Package keyword is recognized before identifiers.
Module keyword is recognized before identifiers.
Import keyword is recognized before identifiers.
Import aliases use the as keyword.
Dotted module paths are tokenized explicitly.
The optional preamble precedes the unchanged beta-0.2 program body.
A package identity may precede the module declaration.
A module identity is represented in the AST scaffold.
Imports may be unaliased or aliased.
The deterministic AST inspection mode exposes provenance without resolving imports.
Only one package declaration is permitted.
Only one module declaration is permitted.
Import aliases must be unique within a source unit.
An import path may appear only once.
Imports require a preceding module declaration.
Package usage requires a module declaration.
Empty path segments are rejected by the grammar.
